requirements.evidence: Code cannot work: wrong trait namespace `use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\HasFactory;` (app/Models/Entity.php:6, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:4); non-existent base class `\Illuminate\Foundation\Http\Controller` (app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:11); `App\Models\Entity::factory()` unqualified inside Database\Factories namespace (database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:19); `$this->entity->membershipFor(...)` called on Entity which has no such method (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:30); invalid SQL `(role = 'owner' ? 1 : NULL) VIRTUAL` instead of a STORED CASE expression (migration:30). Contract misses: enum in App\Enums not App\Models (app/Enums/UserRole.php:3), manageable() returns strings, Livewire routes unnamed and without auth/verified (routes/web.php:55-57), no lang keys, no docs, dashboard lacks welcome/owner notice, removeMember has no last-manager check, transfer returns validation errors instead of 403 and crashes on missing owner (Settings.php:58-68).

conventions.evidence: Hand-written migrations with legacy class syntax and non-generated timestamps (database/migrations/20231029000000_create_entities_table.php:7); domain writes done inline in components instead of app/Actions (Members.php:34, Settings.php:35,44,65); inline validate() arrays rather than #[Validate]; no Bulma markup, hard-coded English strings ('Add', 'Transfer Ownership', settings.blade.php:12); docs/database-schema.md, lang files and CHANGELOG not updated; tests absent despite TDD rule.

security.evidence: Entity routes have no `auth`/`verified` middleware (routes/web.php:50-57); `addMember()` has no authorization, so employees can add members (Members.php:24-39); Settings save/delete/transfer do not authorize per action (Settings.php:28-70); policies compare the enum-cast `role` with string values (`in_array($current->role, [UserRole::Owner->value, ...])`, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:23,36; `=== UserRole::Owner->value` EntityPolicy.php:44), so owner-protection checks (`$membership->role === UserRole::Owner->value`, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:32) never match and the owner's membership can be removed by an admin; assignRole/removeMember don't verify the membership belongs to the page's entity.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files at all; no feature, policy, unauthorized-call or tamper tests.

simplicity.evidence: Code is short, but adds a redundant global `Route::bind('entity', ...)` (routes/web.php:43-45) on top of `{entity:slug}` and getRouteKeyName; repeated role-check logic across policies and views (dashboard.blade.php:3, members.blade.php:10) instead of reusing policies (@can).

readability.evidence: Unused imports (`Auth`, `DB` in Members.php:9-10, `Auth` in Dashboard.php:5); inconsistent fully qualified class names (`\App\Http\Controllers\EntityController::class` despite import, routes/web.php:52); single-line `if (...) return false;` style (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:31); narrating comments like `// Set session`; misleading migration comment about SQLite virtual columns.

scope.evidence: Unrelated reformatting of verification routes and import reshuffle / AuthController FQCN change in routes/web.php:3-4,23,38-39; otherwise the files serve the task.

issues.explanation: `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\HasFactory` does not exist (it is `Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory`), so both models fatal on load.
Extends non-existent `\Illuminate\Foundation\Http\Controller`, so the pick route cannot work.
Generated column uses a C-style ternary (invalid SQL on SQLite and MariaDB) and is VIRTUAL instead of the required STORED column, so the migration fails.
Entity routes have no `auth`/`verified` middleware; guests hit `Auth::user()->membershipFor` on null, and the Livewire routes are also missing the required names `entity.dashboard/members/settings`.
`addMember()` performs no authorization, so any employee can add members.
`role` is cast to the enum but compared with string values, so owner/admin checks always fail (settings unreachable, assignRole always denied) and the owner-membership deletion guard never fires.
Calls `$this->entity->membershipFor()`, which is only defined on User, causing a fatal error on every add.
Unqualified `App\Models\Entity` resolves to `Database\Factories\App\Models\Entity`, so the factory crashes.
No tests are shipped, violating the mandatory TDD convention and the Livewire unauthorized/tamper test requirement.
removeMember lacks the 'never remove the last manager -> 403' check, and assignRole/removeMember don't verify the membership belongs to the bound entity.
Invalid transfer target yields a validation error instead of 403, the caller isn't excluded, and a vanished owner causes a null dereference rather than 403.
save/delete/transfer do not re-authorize `manageSettings` server-side as the Livewire policy requires.
Enum is placed in `App\Enums` instead of the contracted `App\Models\UserRole`, and `manageable()` returns strings instead of `[Admin, Employee]` cases.
Dashboard lacks the welcome and owner notice, the owner check compares an enum to 'owner' so the settings link never shows, and no lang keys were added to lang/*/ui.php.
Migrations are hand-written with legacy class syntax and a fake timestamp instead of `make:migration`, and docs/database-schema.md was not updated.
Domain writes are done inline in components rather than through `app/Actions/*`, and validation doesn't use `#[Validate]`.
Hard-coded English UI strings ('Transfer Ownership', 'Add', 'Remove') and no Bulma markup or labels for inputs.
Unrelated reshuffling of imports and reformatting of the email verification routes.

review.summary: The change sketches the entity models, policies, pick controller and three Livewire pages, but much of it would not run: wrong HasFactory namespace, a non-existent controller base class, invalid generated-column SQL, a broken factory reference and a call to an undefined method. Even past the fatals, the enum-vs-string role comparisons break every policy, the routes lack auth/verified middleware and names, addMember is unauthorized, required behaviours (last-manager guard, 403 on transfer, lang keys, docs) are missing, and no tests ship, so this needs a rewrite.
